### Game Day

On game day here are a few things everyone should do:

- Arrive 15 to 20 minutes early. This allows your player to get ready, and have a pre-game pep and strategy talk.

- Make sure you have your jersey, stick, protection and water.

- Come ready as if you are playing for the cup.

- Next game June 28, 2026 against the Bandits, we are the visiting team.
:::

### Practice

June 26th 5:30PM - 6:30PM at Flexible Arena located at: 290 Motor Pkwy, Hauppauge, NY 11788

From Coach Andrew: 

[https://flexiblearena.com/](https://flexiblearena.com/) This is the arena website for flexible practices. Everyone MUST sign the waiver forms in order to participate. Create an account, sign up for team Phantoms (Andrew Flynn). Please read over arena rules. This is a totally free place, they only ask to follow the rules, sign waiver and keep it clean! Please make best efforts to make it to this practice. Having the full team cooperation and attendance is really going to help our little champions get back into a winning rhythm. Lets go phantoms!
